description: Retrieval baseline for colpali-rag (Qdrant local mode, RRF-60 hybrid). Dev set: evals/golden_queries.json (10 hand-checked queries). Re-verified on 2026-09-25 against the full indexed corpus (5+ demo/uploaded PDFs, 26 points) after the traced three-leg RRF and again after sparse vectors became real named sparse vectors (previously payload-only, silently empty leg).
notes: hybrid: hit@3/5/10 = 1.0; one chart-only gold ('What does the revenue chart show...') sits at rank 1 after the sparse leg became real - BM25 text hits on adjacent text-heavy pages now compete in fusion, slightly lowering mrr@10/ndcg@5 vs the broken-sparse run (1.0). Still every gold inside top-5.
colpali alone is perfect (1.0): the visual late-interaction leg dominates; dense text leg is the weakest (2 golds at rank 1, chart/figure-heavy queries).
The demo corpus (demo/pdfs: NanoSat spec + SaaS cohort report, 8 chart/table-heavy pages) also retrieves its gold pages at rank 0 on all 8 scripted demo questions.
Scores are relatively small-corpus; grow the dev set toward 30-100 queries before relying on the absolute numbers.
Per-query detail (ranks, hits) is archived under evals/results/<mode>.json. Re-run with: uv run python -m colpali_rag.eval --mode hybrid --out evals/results/hybrid.json
